voiceover: At the center of the Christian faith stands one man — Jesus of Nazareth. This section of the Evidence Library takes the honest questions about him one at a time, and shows you where the evidence points. Did he even exist? Virtually every historian, believer or not, says yes. What did he claim about himself — and did his earliest followers worship him as God, not merely admire him as a teacher? How did the first Christians read the Hebrew Scriptures as pointing toward him, and is his story genuinely unlike the older dying-and-rising myths sceptics compare it to? And the question everything turns on: did he rise? The case there begins with a creed the church was already reciting within a few years of the crucifixion — not a legend invented lifetimes later. Every one of these arguments gets a fully-cited deep-dive essay. Each claim is sourced, and the strongest objections are stated fairly, then answered. That is our standard — Checked Before Published. And you will not just read. On every essay an AI tutor answers your questions — ask it anything, or highlight a single sentence and ask about that exact line. Mastery mode lets you explain the argument back in your own words and have it graded. Daily practice brings the key points back just as you are about to forget them. There are pocket cards to share, and a Debate Arena to practise against an AI sceptic before the real conversation. Every essay comes in a plain-English version and a full deep dive, with read-aloud audio. None of this can do your believing for you. What this section makes the case for is that trusting Jesus is not a leap in the dark — it rests on real evidence, honestly weighed. Start anywhere, and follow it where it leads.
